dedupe_keys.name: capisaldi di livellazione igm regione del veneto

description: Capisaldi di livellazione IGM - Regione del Veneto is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idt2.regione.veneto.it. Archive of the IGM high precision leveling pillars, Veneto Region. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "IGM levelling cornerstones — Veneto Region" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include open data. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMTS, WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2009-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
